summary_markdown:
The session focused on debugging inflated data metrics. [me] identified that the reported increase in data (specifically, sessions/impressions) was due to previous data not being deleted before running new aggregations, causing rows to double.

[p1] confirmed the issue and expressed frustration with the process of recalculating item calculations and aggregation.

To resolve the discrepancy, [me] suggested re-aggregating the data. They discussed whether to use `facility_master_num` or aggregate across the entire company. [p1] specified using only the master facility number. The agreed dataset for re-aggregation was `model1`.
decisions: The inflated data metrics were caused by failure to delete previous aggregation runs.
The data needs to be re-aggregated using the 'model1' dataset.
action_items: Schedule a call for the next day (around 12:00) to finalize the data aggregation process.
